notes: a transition's `target` must be one or more IDs of states in the same SCXML document; an unresolved target makes the document non-conformant
diagnostics.help: declare the target state or correct the target identifier

diagnostics.message: a Unicode bidirectional control character changes how this line is displayed
notes: an explicit embedding, override, or isolate reorders how the text around it is displayed, so an editor or review can show a condition, ID, or script differently from what the machine executes (Trojan Source, CVE-2021-42574)
diagnostics.help: if the character is intended, write it as a character reference such as `‮`, which XML decodes to the same character and keeps visible; otherwise remove it
spec_references: Unicode Standard Annex #9 §2 Directional Formatting Characters

fixes.message: write the control character as a character reference
